answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities at the wharf. A newcomer docks and passes a narrow inlet: a month of earnings sits in escrow as nectar, released only when its fingerprint of timing and counterparties stays stable for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 fingerprints at $25 each, $25,000, while each fake's nectar caps at $3. One honest agent pays $25 once and keeps its full share; a mismatch forfeits the escrow.
